The valid command documents in this directory are copies, unmodified, of `examples/schema-command-*.json` of the ATIP contract at tag v1.1.0 (commit da69df042b1140915d6a5e674b306bf7b5cfd187); `invalid/` holds the ones of `examples/invalid/` that break rule 12 (examples) or 13 (validators `rejects`) of spec 10.13 in an `examples[]` or `rejects[]` line. The `data` of each file is the command document. Used by the unit tests of `src/l1/invocation.rs`.
